# Third-party notices

AbraCode-owned code is MIT licensed. This file and the inventory preserve separate upstream terms. No dependency is relicensed under the root MIT grant.

## OpenSpec-derived instructions

The generated OpenSpec workflows and adapted AbraCode skills retain the [OpenSpec contributors copyright and MIT terms](licenses/openspec.txt). AbraCode-specific workflow changes are modifications to those instructions.

## Engineering skill adaptations

The bundled codebase-design, domain-modeling and diagnosing-bugs procedures adapt Matt Pocock’s skills (Copyright (c) 2026 Matt Pocock; [MIT notice](licenses/aihero-skills.txt)). Verification and blast-radius adapt Lauren Tan’s pstack (Copyright (c) 2026 Lauren Tan; [MIT notice](licenses/pstack.txt)). See [the source revision and adaptation inventory](docs/engineering-skills.md) for scope and immutable upstream links.

## shadcn/ui components

Browser primitives in `apps/web/src/components/ui/` adapt shadcn/ui Base Nova component source, generated with shadcn 4.23.0. Local changes adjust imports, formatting and Base UI orientation selectors. The [upstream copyright and full MIT terms](licenses/shadcn-ui.txt) are retained; the frozen source inventory records individual files.

## Installed components

Full pinned provenance and review dispositions: [inventory](licenses/inventory.json). Dependency binaries are downloaded by the operator from their suppliers; they are not included in the source clone. Preserve these notices when distributing derived bundles.

OpenTUI 0.8.4 platform binaries declare MIT AND LGPL-2.1-or-later and include FFmpeg notices. The source clone and offline report artifacts exclude these binaries. Preserve the supplier notices; redistributing binaries needs a separate review of corresponding source and linking requirements.
